On this page
List NT8 Connections

Read the connections configured in your running NinjaTrader instance, including disconnected connections. Each entry reports broker connection status and the separate market-data status.

ELITE

Requires an Elite subscription and a connected CrossTrade add-on. Use your existing API token. See Authentication.

Endpoint​

GET https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/manage/nt8/connections

Headers​
NAME	REQUIRED	VALUE
Authorization	Yes	Bearer <your API token>
If-None-Match	No	ETag from a previous list. Returns 304 with no body when the live snapshot is unchanged
Query parameters​
NAME	TYPE	DEFAULT	DESCRIPTION
refresh	boolean	false	Refresh discovery of configured connections from the NT8 Connections menu

Every call reads live status. refresh=true also refreshes menu discovery; it does not reconnect a broker. Send no request body.

Code examples​
Python
cURL
import requests



resp = requests.get(

    "https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/manage/nt8/connections",

    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"},

    params={"refresh": "true"},

)

print(resp.status_code, resp.json())

Response​
{

  "success": true,

  "data": [

    {

      "name": "Rithmic",

      "provider": "Rithmic",

      "status": "Connected",

      "priceStatus": "Connected",

      "apiDisconnectIntent": false,

      "establishedAt": "2026-10-22T13:00:00Z",

      "uptimeSeconds": 120

    }

  ],

  "meta": {

    "requestId": "req_9f2c1a0b7d3e4f51",

    "count": 1,

    "etag": "\"c2:7Q0xMmZ3bTRkWmRVdz\""

  }

}


See the Connection field reference. Provider credentials and cached provider properties are not returned. The ETag covers the whole snapshot, including uptime, so it can change while a connection stays connected.

Other responses​
STATUS	ERROR	WHEN
304		If-None-Match matched; no body
400	unexpected_body, unknown_parameter	A body or an unknown/repeated query parameter was sent
401	unauthorized	Missing or invalid API token
403	elite_required, not_available	See Authentication
409	addon_disconnected	NinjaTrader or the CrossTrade add-on is offline
422	validation_failed	refresh is not a valid boolean
429	rate_limited, too_many_concurrent_requests	See Rate limits
503	addon_unavailable	The add-on timed out, returned an error, or could not provide a valid inventory
503	management_unavailable, family_unavailable, management_busy	See Errors

Use Connect and Disconnect for immediate commands. Saved auto-reconnect, watchdog, and reconnect-action policies remain under Connection Settings.
